purpose: Delegate coding to a bounded Codex CLI process with pinned artifacts and scoped permissions.

trigger: Use Codex CLI to implement a feature in an isolated worktree
Ask Codex to review changes without applying them
Recover the outcome of a Codex CLI development run
do_not_trigger: Explain Codex licensing in general terms
Start an unlimited unattended process with all permissions
Create a calendar meeting instead of touching code

preflight: Verify exact Codex executable, version, provider identity and billing budget.
Pin target repo/worktree, branch SHA, allowed tools and review authority.
For hosted/remote or autonomous code execution, require exact owner authorization.
workflow: Issue a bounded task brief and target revision to a fresh process.
Capture structured logs, process exit, proposed patch and tool actions.
Verify changed files and run targeted tests independent of agent prose.
Stop worker at budget/cancellation boundary; preserve safe state.

evidence.how_to_verify: Capture exact repo/branch and status before agent starts.
Retain bounded read-only findings with exact file/line references.
Owner approves process permissions, tool/network scope and cost budget.
Read back exact isolated worktree diff and final head SHA.
Capture independent targeted test process exit and artifacts.

failure_modes: On worker crash, reconcile actual worktree and external actions before restarting.
Do not infer success from a session end or fluent final message.
